and_chain.rationale: B1-B5 are deterministic predicates on a genuine bundle (valid server signature, within expiry, unconsumed nonce, advancing counter, recomputing digest) and reject genuine traffic only when something is actually wrong. They carry no BPCER budget, so B6 absorbs all of it and its required TPR is the system target itself, not the sixth root of it.

dataset_versions.injection_corpus: self-generated, scripts/make_injection_corpus.py (see its manifest for its own git_commit)

note: Calibrated strict on TPR and permissive on FAR, the inverse of the 2026-09-02 derivation. Rationale in `and_chain`: six ANDed checks compound false rejects and suppress false accepts, and five of the six are deterministic, so B6 carries the whole system BPCER budget. Captures no biometric data and retains no frames -- per-frame region colour means only.

evidence_strength.caveat: measured TPR of 1.00 on this many captures does NOT demonstrate the 5% system BPCER target -- the 95% upper bound on BPCER is far above it. The threshold is derived to meet the target; the evidence bounds it only loosely. One room, one sensor, no subject at capture distance.

recommendation.selection_rule: cheapest capture among operating points within 0.02 of the best two-sided margin (0.143); margin standard error with 8 positives is approximately 0.02, so smaller differences are not resolvable by this data
